rising_uppercut.name: Rising Uppercut
rising_uppercut.description: A fast upward blow that knocks one foe down. Cancels a landed combo.

whirlwind_kick.name: Whirlwind Kick
whirlwind_kick.description: A spinning kick that hits enemies on both sides.

shoulder_rush.name: Shoulder Rush
shoulder_rush.description: Charge forward through a line of foes. Breaks guard.

furnace_slam.name: Furnace Slam
furnace_slam.description: Smash the street with a burning fist. Heavy damage all around. Breaks guard.

headbutt.name: Headbutt
headbutt.description: A crushing headbutt that stuns one foe for a long time. Breaks guard.

clothesline.name: Clothesline
clothesline.description: Step in with a long arm sweep that knocks down everything in front.

shoulder_charge.name: Shoulder Charge
shoulder_charge.description: Barrel forward like a freight train, flattening a whole line. Breaks guard.

earthshaker.name: Earthshaker
earthshaker.description: Pound the street hard enough to crack it. Huge damage all around. Breaks guard.

liver_shot.name: Liver Shot
liver_shot.description: A short hook to the body that stuns one foe for a long time. The fastest skill in the crew.

one_two.name: One-Two
one_two.description: Step in behind a jab and a cross that knock down everything in front.

dempsey_roll.name: Dempsey Roll
dempsey_roll.description: Weave forward through a line of foes, hooking each one down. Breaks guard.

knockout_blow.name: Knockout Blow
knockout_blow.description: Everything into one straight right. The shockwave flattens foes all around. Breaks guard.

hotbar.name: Attack
hotbar.description: Jab, cross, hook: press again as each blow lands to keep the combo going. Also Z or J. No cooldown. Heavy attack: X or K (costs energy).
